reason: A strict +0.01 EV-C-minus-EV-B rule is mathematically impossible when an eligibility dimension is already saturated or nearly saturated in EV-B. This refinement is made before feasibility execution and before any Candidate-v13 external output. It does not change stage sizes, source shares, domain totals, family totals, answerability totals, performance thresholds, gold mapping, or formal one-shot rules.

classification.testable: After a feasible EV-B selection is obtained but before Candidate-v13 execution, the dimension has >=100 eligible remaining EV-C-reserve bases and EV-B selected proportion <=0.98.
classification.saturated_not_testable: EV-B selected proportion >0.98, so a guaranteed +0.01 increase would exceed or nearly exceed probability 1.0. EV-C must not have a lower proportion, but the dimension does not count toward the required increase set.
classification.insufficient_reserve_not_testable: Fewer than 100 eligible remaining EV-C-reserve bases. Report as coverage limitation; do not use it to claim EV-C is harder.

testable_dimension_rule: EV-C selected proportion must exceed EV-B by >=0.01.
saturated_dimension_rule: EV-C selected proportion must be >= EV-B proportion; report saturation explicitly and do not claim a measured increase.
global_success_rule: At least four stress dimensions must be testable and must each satisfy +0.01. Every saturated dimension must be non-decreasing. Dimensions with insufficient reserve are reported but do not rescue failure of a testable dimension.
selection_order: Unchanged: EV-B tie-breaks toward lower stress_count and EV-C toward higher stress_count within otherwise feasible source/domain/family assignments. No model output participates.
